summary: First testing pass for FiskID MVP. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests PASSED covering register/login/me/forgot/reset/fiscal-profile validation/upsert/shares/public-share/confirm/revoke/invalid-token. Frontend: full flow works end-to-end on Expo web preview at mobile viewport 390x844 — register → onboarding → fiscal-profile/edit → dashboard shows 'Mario Rossi' + 'Privato' + 'Condividi dati fiscali'; /card shows sections and sticky share button; /share shows QR + share URL + Copia link + Genera nuovo QR; /share/{token} unauthenticated shows fiscal data + Copia tutti + Conferma acquisizione (all present).

issues: Console warnings (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props deprecated, use boxShadow; props.pointerEvents deprecated, use style.pointerEvents; Animated useNativeDriver not supported on web (RCTAnimation missing) - falls back to JS animation.

'Salta' text button was not directly click-reachable by page.get_by_text('Salta') on first pass (worked via direct navigation). testID for skip button would help; also on first register attempt a stray 'GO_BACK action was not handled by any navigator' console error appeared — indicates a router back call with no history. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Add testID='onboarding-skip' and 'onboarding-continue' on the onboarding step buttons for easier automation.
(Optional) Guard router.back() on register/login screens to avoid the 'GO_BACK was not handled' warning when user lands directly on /register.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly returns 'id' string and excludes _id/user_id from public/private profile responses (verified in tests).
Login returns generic 401 for both unknown email and wrong password (uses DUMMY_HASH to prevent user-enumeration timing) — good.
forgot-password returns dev_reset_token only when user exists in dev mode; response message is generic — matches requirement.
Fiscal profile is properly upserted (one document per user, unique index on user_id).
seed_data_creation: Fresh users created dynamically: tester+<ts>@fiskid.it / password123 (backend pytest suite) and separate fresh user in frontend Playwright run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend testIDs of interest: register-{email-input,password-input,confirm-input,submit-button}; entity-{individual,professional,company}; input-{first-name,last-name,cf,recipient,pec,address,street-number,cap,city,province,country,email,phone}; edit-save-button. Note tax-code testID is 'input-cf' (not 'input-tax-code') and CAP is 'input-cap'. Public share URL pattern: /share/{token}. Test backend BASE via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found blocking the reviewed features.
